#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate SVG charts for the EU economic data storytelling report."""
import os

os.makedirs("charts", exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- palette
BLUE   = "#2E86AB"
RED    = "#E63946"
GREEN  = "#2A9D8F"
ORANGE = "#E9A13B"
PURPLE = "#7B5EA7"
GRAY   = "#6C757D"
GRID   = "#E6E6E6"
DARK   = "#222222"

COLORS = [BLUE, RED, GREEN, ORANGE, PURPLE, GRAY, "#4C956C"]

FONT = 'font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"'


def esc(s):
    return str(s).replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")


def text(x, y, s, size=12, anchor="start", fill=DARK, weight="normal", italic=False):
    style = f"font-style:{'italic' if italic else 'normal'}"
    return (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" font-size="{size}" text-anchor="{anchor}" '
            f'fill="{fill}" font-weight="{weight}" {style}>{esc(s)}</text>')


def title_block(w, title, subtitle):
    return (text(w / 2, 42, title, size=22, anchor="middle", weight="bold", fill="#1B2A41") +
            text(w / 2, 66, subtitle, size=13, anchor="middle", fill=GRAY, italic=True))


def vline(x1, y1, x2, y2, stroke=GRID, width=1):
    return f'<line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" stroke="{stroke}" stroke-width="{width}"/>'


def hline(x1, y1, x2, y2, stroke=GRID, width=1):
    return vline(x1, y1, x2, y2, stroke, width)


def polyline(pts, stroke, width=3):
    coords = " ".join(f"{x:.1f},{y:.1f}" for x, y in pts)
    return (f'<polyline points="{coords}" fill="none" stroke="{stroke}" '
            f'stroke-width="{width}" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>')


def circle(x, y, r, fill):
    return f'<circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="{r}" fill="{fill}"/>'


def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, opacity=1.0):
    return (f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{y:.1f}" width="{w:.1f}" height="{h:.1f}" '
            f'fill="{fill}" opacity="{opacity}"/>')


def legend(x, y, items, size=12, dy=22):
    """items: list of (label, color)"""
    out = []
    cx = x
    for label, color in items:
        out.append(rect(cx, y - 9, 16, 16, color))
        out.append(text(cx + 22, y + 3, label, size=size, fill="#333"))
        cx += 22 + len(label) * size * 0.62 + 28
    return "".join(out)


def line_chart(path, title, subtitle, series, x_labels, y_label,
               y_min, y_max, y_ticks, height=520, width=960,
               y_fmt=lambda v: f"{v:g}", x_fmt=None, highlight=None):
    """series: list of (name, color, [(x_index, value), ...])"""
    ml, mr, mt, mb = 78, 30, 100, 62
    pw, ph = width - ml - mr, height - mt - mb
    px = lambda i: ml + pw * (i / (len(x_labels) - 1))
    py = lambda v: mt + ph * (1 - (v - y_min) / (y_max - y_min))

    out = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" {FONT}>',
           f'<rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white"/>']
    out.append(title_block(width, title, subtitle))

    # grid + y labels
    for t in y_ticks:
        yy = py(t)
        out.append(hline(ml, yy, ml + pw, yy))
        out.append(text(ml - 10, yy + 4, y_fmt(t), size=11, anchor="end", fill=GRAY))
    # x labels
    for i, lab in enumerate(x_labels):
        out.append(text(px(i), mt + ph + 24, lab, size=12, anchor="middle", fill=DARK, weight="bold"))
    out.append(text(ml, mt + ph + 46, y_label, size=11, anchor="middle", fill=GRAY))

    # series
    for name, color, pts in series:
        mapped = [(px(i), py(v)) for i, v in pts]
        out.append(polyline(mapped, color))
        for i, v in pts:
            if x_fmt:
                lab = x_fmt(i, v, name)
            else:
                lab = y_fmt(v)
            out.append(circle(px(i), py(v), 4.5, color))
            out.append(text(px(i), py(v) - 10, lab, size=10.5, anchor="middle", fill=color, weight="bold"))

    out.append(legend(ml, mt + ph - 6, [(n, c) for n, c, _ in series]))
    out.append("</svg>")
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out))
    print("wrote", path)


def grouped_bar_chart(path, title, subtitle, groups, series_names, y_label,
                      y_min, y_max, y_ticks, height=520, width=1000,
                      y_fmt=lambda v: f"{v:g}", value_fmt=lambda v: f"{v:g}",
                      bar_colors=None, value_dy=8):
    """groups: list of (group_label, [values...]) aligned with series_names"""
    ng = len(groups)
    ns = len(series_names)
    ml, mr, mt, mb = 70, 30, 100, 70
    pw, ph = width - ml - mr, height - mt - mb
    group_w = pw / ng
    bar_w = min(group_w * 0.62 / ns, 54)
    gap = (group_w - bar_w * ns) / 2
    py = lambda v: mt + ph * (1 - (v - y_min) / (y_max - y_min))

    out = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" {FONT}>',
           f'<rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white"/>']
    out.append(title_block(width, title, subtitle))

    for t in y_ticks:
        yy = py(t)
        out.append(hline(ml, yy, ml + pw, yy))
        out.append(text(ml - 10, yy + 4, y_fmt(t), size=11, anchor="end", fill=GRAY))
    # zero line
    if y_min < 0 < y_max:
        out.append(hline(ml, py(0), ml + pw, py(0), stroke="#999999", width=1.2))

    for gi, (glabel, values) in enumerate(groups):
        gx = ml + gi * group_w
        out.append(text(gx + group_w / 2, mt + ph + 24, glabel, size=12,
                        anchor="middle", fill=DARK, weight="bold"))
        for si, v in enumerate(values):
            c = bar_colors[si] if bar_colors else COLORS[si % len(COLORS)]
            bx = gx + gap + si * bar_w
            h = abs(py(v) - py(0)) if y_min < 0 < y_max else abs(py(v) - py(min(y_ticks)))
            yy = py(v) if y_min < 0 < y_max else py(v)
            hh = py(0) - py(v) if y_min < 0 < y_max else py(v) - py(min(y_ticks))
            if y_min < 0 < y_max:
                out.append(rect(bx, min(yy, py(0)), bar_w, abs(py(0) - yy), c, opacity=0.88))
            else:
                out.append(rect(bx, yy, bar_w, hh, c, opacity=0.88))
            out.append(text(bx + bar_w / 2, yy - value_dy, value_fmt(v), size=10,
                            anchor="middle", fill=DARK, weight="bold"))

    out.append(legend(ml, mt + ph - 6, list(zip(series_names, bar_colors or COLORS))))
    out.append("</svg>")
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out))
    print("wrote", path)


YEARS = ["2022", "2023", "2024"]

# ================================================================ Chart 1
# EU headline: growth (bars) vs inflation (line)
line_chart(
    "charts/eu_headline.svg",
    "Taming Inflation Without a Recession",
    "EU inflation collapsed from 9.2% (2022) to 2.4% (2024) while growth stayed positive — a rare soft landing",
    [("Inflation (%)", RED, [(0, 9.2), (1, 6.4), (2, 2.4)])],
    YEARS, "percent", 0, 10, [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10],
    height=480, width=900,
)

# ================================================================ Chart 2
# GDP growth by country
growth = {
    "Germany": [1.8, 0.0, -0.3],
    "France": [2.5, 0.7, 0.9],
    "Italy": [3.7, 0.7, 0.5],
    "Spain": [5.8, 2.5, 3.2],
    "Netherlands": [4.3, 0.1, 0.7],
    "Poland": [5.1, 0.2, 3.0],
    "Sweden": [2.6, -0.2, 0.8],
}
grouped_bar_chart(
    "charts/gdp_growth.svg",
    "A Two-Speed Recovery",
    "Spain leads the bloc at 3.2% in 2024 while Germany — Europe's largest economy — slips into contraction",
    [(c, growth[c]) for c in growth],
    YEARS, "Real GDP growth (%)", -1, 6.5, [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    bar_colors=[BLUE, ORANGE, GREEN], value_dy=6,
)

# ================================================================ Chart 3
# Trade balance trajectory
tb = {
    "EU Total": [(-198.4), (-32.1), (-8.3)],
    "Germany": [-84.3, -21.1, -15.8],
    "France": [-163.6, -99.5, -84.2],
    "Italy": [-0.8, 28.1, 42.6],
    "Spain": [-69.4, -37.9, -24.3],
    "Netherlands": [78.2, 85.9, 79.1],
}
line_chart(
    "charts/trade_balance.svg",
    "From Deep Deficit to Near Balance",
    "The EU's trade balance improved by €190 billion in two years — Italy swung from deficit to a €42.6B surplus",
    [(c, COLORS[i % len(COLORS)], [(0, v[0]), (1, v[1]), (2, v[2])]) for i, (c, v) in enumerate(tb.items())],
    YEARS, "Trade balance (€ billion)", -220, 110, [-200, -150, -100, -50, 0, 50, 100],
    y_fmt=lambda v: f"{v:g}", height=520, width=960,
)

# ================================================================ Chart 4
# Public debt
debt = {
    "EU Total": [84.0, 81.7, 80.1],
    "Germany": [66.3, 63.6, 62.9],
    "France": [111.8, 110.6, 112.0],
    "Italy": [141.7, 137.3, 134.8],
    "Spain": [113.2, 107.7, 104.3],
}
line_chart(
    "charts/public_debt.svg",
    "Fiscal Consolidation, Broadly Shared",
    "Public debt fell across the EU from 84.0% to 80.1% of GDP — even high-debt Italy cut 6.9 percentage points",
    [(c, COLORS[i % len(COLORS)], [(0, v[0]), (1, v[1]), (2, v[2])]) for i, (c, v) in enumerate(debt.items())],
    YEARS, "Public debt (% of GDP)", 20, 160, [20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160],
    y_fmt=lambda v: f"{v:g}", height=520, width=960,
)

# ================================================================ Chart 5
# Unemployment
unemp = {
    "Germany": [3.1, 3.0, 3.4],
    "France": [7.3, 7.1, 7.5],
    "Italy": [8.1, 7.6, 6.9],
    "Spain": [12.9, 12.1, 11.3],
    "Netherlands": [3.5, 3.6, 3.8],
    "Poland": [2.9, 2.8, 3.0],
    "Sweden": [7.5, 7.7, 8.4],
}
line_chart(
    "charts/unemployment.svg",
    "Labor Markets Held Their Ground",
    "Unemployment stayed near record lows even as growth slowed — Spain cut its rate from 12.9% to 11.3%",
    [(c, COLORS[i % len(COLORS)], [(0, v[0]), (1, v[1]), (2, v[2])]) for i, (c, v) in enumerate(unemp.items())],
    YEARS, "Unemployment rate (%)", 0, 14, [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14],
    y_fmt=lambda v: f"{v:g}", height=520, width=960,
)

print("All charts generated.")

    for i, v in pts:
        out.append(circle(px(i), pyr(v), 4.5, color))
        out.append(text(px(i), pyr(v) - 10, f"{v:g}", size=10.5, anchor="middle", fill=color, weight="bold"))

    out.append(legend(ml, mt + ph - 6, [("Real GDP growth (%)", GREEN), (name, color)]))
    out.append("</svg>")
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out))
    print("wrote", path)
